name: Bootlegger Milkwood
address: Shop G14, Milkwood Square, Main Rd, Knysna, 6571, South Africa
description_short: Artisan coffee roastery and cafe in Milkwood Square serving specialty brews and fresh, locally-inspired food.
description_long:
Tucked into Milkwood Square along Knysna's Main Road, Bootlegger Milkwood brings serious coffee credentials to the Garden Route. This is where craft roasting meets neighbourhood cafe vibes — expect properly pulled espressos, pour-overs that highlight single origins, and a menu built around fresh, wholesome ingredients.

The food lineup runs from hearty breakfasts and stacked sandwiches to salads and daily specials that lean into local flavours. It's the kind of place where you can linger over a flat white and a slice of something homemade, or grab a quick bite before exploring Knysna. The space itself is relaxed and welcoming, with indoor seating and a laid-back atmosphere that suits solo workers, catch-ups with friends, or families needing a caffeine pit stop.

Whether you're a coffee purist chasing the perfect bean or just after a reliable breakfast spot in central Knysna, Bootlegger Milkwood delivers without fuss. It's honest cafe culture with attention to detail.
